The '''Republic Army Special Forces Academy''' was a military training institute of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for top [[Republic soldier]]s. The Academy's high expectations meant successful trainees were typically deployed into combat as [[Republic Special Forces Division|Special Forces]] personnel of the [[Republic Army]] immediately.
